text: 金十数据7月11日讯，本周美伊战火重燃以来，霍尔木兹海峡过境量明显下降。据Kpler数据，周四过境量从前一日的30艘降至22艘。当地时间周二，伊朗瞄准海峡船只（包括一艘卡塔尔LNG运输船受损）后双方冲突再度爆发。Kpler数据显示，自周二双方互袭以来，仅有两艘LNG船进入海峡，一艘驶出。6月17日美伊签署协议开启结束冲突谈判后过境量曾有所增加，数日后达峰值，随后停火被打破。船运经纪公司Braemar LNG周五在客户报告中称，船东持谨慎态度，已从该地区撤出可用运力，“直至地缘政治局势更加明朗”。此举减少了可用船只数量，推高了运输成本。
text_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Since the renewed conflict between the US and Iran this week, transit volume through the Strait of Hormuz has declined significantly. According to Kpler data, transit volume on Thursday dropped to 22 vessels from 30 the previous day. On Tuesday local time, conflicts escalated after Iran targeted vessels in the strait, including damage to a Qatari LNG carrier. Kpler data shows that since the mutual attacks began on Tuesday, only two LNG vessels entered the strait, while one departed. Transit volume had increased after the US-Iran agreement on June 17 to begin conflict-ending negotiations, peaking a few days later before the ceasefire broke down. Shipping brokerage Braemar LNG stated in a client report Friday that shipowners are cautious and have withdrawn available capacity from the region, 'until the geopolitical situation becomes clearer.' This move reduces the number of available vessels, pushing up transportation costs.
